claims.claim: Supplier K lot K-771 is a necessary exposure for all confirmed hazy batches.
Confirmed hazy batches span multiple raw-material supplier lots but share Line 3 exposure.
Siloxane is detected downstream of the temporary Line 3 hose but not in matched upstream material.
Replacing the temporary Line 3 hose while keeping raw-material lot and process settings fixed eliminates the observed haze in the canary.
